# Omni-Matrix Publisher

Manages OAuth social account matrices and visual content calendars across 14+ global and China platforms:
- Adapts titles, hashtags, character limits, and SEO metadata per channel automatically.
- Schedules optimal time slots with duplicate-publish protection.
- Enforces mandatory Human-in-the-Loop approval before executing any live publish action.
